Residential lease (extract)

Landlord: Lindenmatt Property Ltd, Emmen, represented by Isla Foster
Tenant: Grace Frei

Premises: 4.5-room flat, 2nd floor, Wiesenstrasse 98, Emmen, with underfloor heating, balcony and cellar compartment

Use: The premises are let as a family dwelling for the tenant and her children. Any other use, including subletting of individual rooms, requires the landlord's written consent.

Start of lease: 1 February 2023
Monthly rent: CHF 3310, including advance payment for heating and service charges

Emmen, 31 December 2022
Lindenmatt Property Ltd, Isla Foster
Grace Frei

questions.label: Q1
questions.question: Does the claim state that the tenant intends to pay the rent on deposit with the office designated by the canton instead of to the landlord, or has begun to do so?

questions.label: Q2
questions.question: Does the claim state that the landlord learned of the defect only orally, so that no written notice, written acknowledgement or inspection record of it exists?

questions.label: Q3
questions.question: Does the claim state that at least one rent payment has already been paid into deposit with the office designated by the canton?

questions.label: Q4
questions.question: Does the claim state that the rented dwelling has a defect (for example mould, damp, or heating that fails) or that the tenant is disturbed in using the dwelling as agreed, without the claim itself saying that the tenant alone caused the defect or must remedy it at his own expense?

questions.label: Q5
questions.question: Does the claim state that the landlord does not yet know of the defect (the tenant has not reported it and the landlord has not learned of it in another way)?

questions.label: Q6
questions.question: Does the tenant claim compensation from the landlord for damage the defect caused to the tenant (for example damaged furniture or clothing, or extra costs)?

text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I'll admit straight away that my landlord, Lindenmatt Property Ltd, has no idea yet about what's going on. I haven't told Ms Isla Foster or anyone else there, and nobody from Lindenmatt has been in the building since the autumn, so they can't have heard about it some other way. My friend Henry Wälti thinks I should have written to them first, which is partly why I'm contacting you.

The problem: since 27 January 2026 the underfloor heating in two of the three bedrooms of my flat at Wiesenstrasse 98 in Emmen has not worked at all. The floor is cold, and the rooms don't get above 14 degrees even with the thermostat turned right up. My two children have been sleeping in the living room with me for over a month. The bathroom is also much colder than before.

I was so angry that I didn't pay the March rent of CHF 3310 to Lindenmatt. I paid it into the official rent deposit account at the cantonal office instead, at the end of February, and I have the receipt.

I also plan to keep doing that every month from now on, depositing the rent there rather than paying it to the landlord, until the heating is repaired.

I've attached my lease. I'd be grateful if you could tell me whether I have handled this correctly and what I need to do next.

Kind regards,
Grace Frei
